name: nfsen-ng
description: nfsen-ng is a modern, in-place replacement for the ageing NfSen web frontend. It sits on top of the nfdump tools and visualises NetFlow / sFlow / IPFIX traffic with real-time SSE push, a responsive light/dark UI, Sankey traffic-flow diagrams, and RRD or VictoriaMetrics storage. This is the WEB UI. It only displays flow data that a collector has already written to its data directory. Install the companion "nfsen-ng-nfcapd" collector template (or run the bundled Compose stack) and mount BOTH containers on the SAME appdata path so the UI can read what the collector writes. A device on your network (pfSense/OPNsense/MikroTik/…) must export flows to the collector. The app does not terminate TLS by design; front it with SWAG, Nginx Proxy Manager, or Traefik.

paths.name: Data (profiles)
paths.description: nfdump profiles/flow-file directory. MUST be the same path the collector writes to.

paths.name: App data
paths.description: nfsen-ng's own data: RRD database (rrd/) plus saved preferences and alert rules/state/log (state/). Keep this on a persistent path so it survives image updates.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: nfsen-ng web interface (OpenSwoole HTTP). Front with a reverse proxy for TLS.

variables.name: Sources
variables.description: Comma-separated source names. Each must exist as live/name under the data directory — i.e. match the collector's output sub-directory.

variables.name: Tracked ports
variables.description: Comma-separated port numbers tracked per source in RRD.

variables.name: nfdump profiles path
variables.description: Container-side profiles path. Must equal the 'Data (profiles)' mount target above.

variables.name: nfdump binary
variables.description: Path to the nfdump binary inside the container.

variables.name: Log level
variables.description: DEBUG, INFO, NOTICE, WARNING, ERR, CRIT, ALERT or EMERG.

variables.name: Import years
variables.description: Backfill window (years) processed on first start.
